units.rawText: Ugh...

units.rawText: I'm sending this cipher key to you. It will allow you to enter the data center of Gabon Research Base on earth and activate the reset system.

units.rawText: The following is my last will and testament.
units.displayText: The following is my last will and testament.

spans.text: The following is my last will and testament.

units.rawText: As the administrator of Jiutian sector, I have accompanied Jiutian over the course of its life. From the moment I was awakened, the importance of my task and its value has been constantly drilled into me.
units.displayText: As the administrator of Jiutian sector, I have accompanied Jiutian over the course of its life. From the moment I was awakened, the importance of my task and its value has been constantly drilled into me.

spans.text: As the administrator of Jiutian sector, I have accompanied Jiutian over the course of its life. From the moment I was awakened, the importance of my task and its value has been constantly drilled into me.

units.rawText: The importance of Jiutian sector has been written into my base layer logic. It has always been a source of pride for me...
units.displayText: The importance of Jiutian sector has been written into my base layer logic. It has always been a source of pride for me...

spans.text: The importance of Jiutian sector has been written into my base layer logic. It has always been a source of pride for me...

units.rawText: But now... During this time of crisis, I realize that what I truly took pride in was the fact that I built this Jiutian sector with you.
